reviews.title: Convenient and Easy to Use
reviews.text: I stumbled upon this app searching for something to use while traveling (we are full time travelers). Some days I just have a few minutes while others I am able to carve out more time after we set up camp and this app allows for all of that! I am a person who needs the “instruction” I literally depend on someone telling me how to get into the pose and how long to hold it and how I should be breathing so these workouts suit me just fine. Thankful that I found the app and its user friendly with so many options to suit your workout needs.

reviews.title: Glad that this app came back
reviews.text: I used to have this app back in 2018 but then when i tried to return to the app in 2021 it was not updated and buggy. Coming back today to see that it was updated 7 months ago and it’s optimized better than it was before made me happy. If you’re reading this, this app is literally free and if you rate it 5 stars, you can access all videos for free. Rating it to unlock them all is better than paying for a subscription. The only con there is that you have to only pay to remove the annoying ads that pop up every time you open a video or new section. This is a hidden gem for yoga, if you dislike the app so much just look up the yoga videos from the app on YouTube, I followed Leslie Fightmaster’s 30 day beginner program on the app and continued with her 90 day yoga fix on YouTube.
